question.problem: A regular pentagon has the same perimeter as an equilateral triangle whose side is $15\,\mathrm{cm}.$ Find the length of the side of the pentagon.
question.worked_solution:
Since all the sides of an equilateral triangle are equal, its perimeter is 

$$
p=3\cdot 15=45.
$$

Let $a$ be the side of the pentagon. We know that our polygons have equal perimeters. Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}p & =5a \\ 45 & =5a \\ 9 & =a.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the length of the side is $9 \,\mathrm{cm}.$
